verdict.rationale: Orb's docs support pieces of safe pricing change. You can test pricing changes against historical usage before deploying. Per-subscription edits change pricing without altering the plan, with an invoice-impact preview. Plan changes are prorated and keep a preserved audit trail, and plan templates accept per-customer overrides. However, nothing documents plan versioning, explicit grandfathering of existing subscribers on old prices, or bulk tools to move cohorts to new prices; edits are described as single-subscription only. missing for 10: versioned plans, explicit grandfathering, bulk/cohort price migration tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
